'''Keelkana racing''' was a sport practiced in [[Calamari sector/Legends|Mon Calamari Space]] that involved players riding trained [[Keelkana/Legends|keelkana]] [[Eel/Legends|eels]]. Its popularity greatly increased during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="Strongholds" />In a Keelkana race, competitors raced on a track or course and the first to finish would be granted winner.
